recognize_zh: 高倍下肝竇內浸潤細胞形態混雜：核大、染色質細緻帶小核仁或核有摺痕的未成熟髓系/單核系細胞，夾雜深黑小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與分節核中性球；多系混合而非單一母細胞群，是 JMML 肝臟浸潤的特徵。
features: Sinusoids between hepatocyte plates filled by a polymorphous hematopoietic infiltrate
Immature myelomonocytic cells with round to reniform/folded nuclei, vesicular fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Erythroid precursors with small, round, very dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Elongated endothelial nuclei lining sinusoids; hepatocytes preserved
describe_en: High-power H&E section of liver shows sinusoids expanded by a polymorphous hematopoietic infiltrate between intact hepatocyte plates. The infiltrate consists of immature myelomonocytic cells with round to folded nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered band and segmented granulocytes. A monotonous sheet of blasts is not present, and megakaryocytes are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hepatic sinusoidal involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic setting.

ddx.vs: Includes megakaryocytes and orderly erythroid/granulocytic maturation without monocytic predominance and occurs in a non-clonal setting.
Composed of a monotonous population of blasts with little maturation, highlighted by CD34/CD117.
Cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin-positive, mainly in portal tracts/bile ducts.
